recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-34768 unless a future broader cleanup revisits unrelated validity details in the overview example.
issue_request: FHIR-34768 was a Published/Persuasive technical correction asking that the FHIR developer overview example stop showing Patient.name.family as an array because HumanName.family is 0..1 and is serialized as a single string in JSON.
initial_application: The issue was previously applied by commit 36d6d3ab7a55c52040de3edc45e62de2111b9b0d, which changed source/overview-dev.html from a family array containing "Levin" to the scalar string "family": "Levin".
additional_context: source/overview-dev.html is in current build scope through source/hierarchy.xml and publish.ini. The HumanName datatype source still defines HumanName.family as 0..1 string. Bounded Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later or conflicting decision requiring another source change.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current source already satisfies the issue and no source edit is needed.
